scriptedVariables.name: sapObjectId
scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};return read('sapObjectId','objectId','object_id','OrderID','InvoiceID','businessObject.id','event.objectId','detail.objectId');

scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};return read('sapObjectType','objectType','object_type','businessObject.type','event.objectType','detail.objectType')||'SAP object';

scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};return read('severity','level','priority','event.severity','detail.severity')||'Medium';

scriptedVariables.name: sapSummary
scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};const direct=read('summary','title','message','errorMessage','event.message','detail.message');if(direct)return direct;const type=read('sapObjectType','objectType','businessObject.type')||'SAP object';const id=read('sapObjectId','objectId','businessObject.id')||'unknown';return type+' exception '+id;

scriptedVariables.name: sapDescription
scriptedVariables.script:
const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};const escapeHtml=(value)=>String(value||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>');const objectId=read('sapObjectId','objectId','businessObject.id');const objectType=read('sapObjectType','objectType','businessObject.type');const process=read('process','businessProcess','processName');const details=read('description','details','errorDetails','message','errorMessage','event.message','detail.message');return '

Source: SAP S/4HANA

Object: '+escapeHtml(objectType)+' '+escapeHtml(objectId)+'

Process: '+escapeHtml(process)+'

'+escapeHtml(details)+'

';
